title: Set up the integral
text: Above the polar axis means θ goes from $$0$$ to $$\pi$$ so the area is $$A=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}**{\pi}(2+\sin\theta)**2\,d\theta$$

title: Evaluate
text: Expand to $$4+4sin\left(\theta\right)+sin^2\left(\theta\right)$$. The three parts integrate to $$4\pi$$, $$8$$, and $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$, so $$A=\frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{9\pi}{2}+8\right)=\frac{9\pi}{4}+4$$.
